pools.ruling: Scoped: it renders under a crisis and line 1 says the roads bring the custom, which a siege contradicts.

lines.text: Market day is {settlement} at its truest: the roads bring the custom, and the custom is the argument for the stalls.
{settlement}'s market lives off through-traffic; the town sells to the road as much as to itself.
A stranger finds {settlement}'s market without directions, because the busiest way through town leads there on its own.
The market was where the carts already stopped; the stalls came to the stopping, and {settlement} grew around the habit.

pools.ruling: Colour, not scoped: a self-serving market asserts no calm.

lines.text: {settlement}'s market serves the town itself; little passes through that was not always coming here.
What {settlement} makes, {settlement} mostly buys from itself, and the market is the room where that happens.
No great road feeds {settlement}'s market, and the market has made its peace with that: it is a town's exchange, not a region's.

pools.ruling: Scoped: lines 2-3 describe goods flowing through the stalls now, which a siege contradicts.

lines.text: {settlement}'s market handles more than the town could ever use; the difference is the town's living.
Half of what changes hands in {settlement} is only pausing here, and the town has built itself around the pause.
In {settlement} the {good} on the stalls has usually seen more of the world than the people selling it.

pools.ruling: Not scoped (no calm); both lines presume a gate and an inn, so most market-less births would draw nothing: one twin added.

lines.text: No market or fair stands in {settlement}: what trade the town does is done at the gate, at the inn and on the road.
A stranger finds no market square in {settlement}, only trade done at the gate, at the inn and along the road.

twins.text: No market or fair stands in {settlement}: what trade the town does is done house to house and on the road.
twins.why: Both pool lines need a gate and an inn; a small market-less town usually has neither, leaving the slot empty.
